seo.title: How to Get Started with Vantage and MetaTrader | LTE
seo.description: Open a Vantage account, verify your ID and log in to MetaTrader 4 or 5 on desktop or mobile. A step-by-step guide from Learn Try Earn.

top.h11: How to get started, *step by step.*
top.p1: Open an account with our broker, Vantage, verify your details and connect it to MetaTrader 4 or MetaTrader 5. Most people are set up within a working day.
top.p2: An email address and phone number, a photo ID (passport, driving licence or national ID card) and a proof of address dated within the last few months, such as a utility bill or bank statement.

account.p1: Four steps from sign-up to a funded account. Exact screens differ a little by country.
account.p2: Go to the Open Live Account page using our link, choose an **Individual** account, then enter your country, email, phone number and a password. This creates your Vantage Client Portal login.
account.p3: Complete your profile and upload a photo ID and proof of address. This is a standard anti-money-laundering (KYC) check. Review usually takes up to one business day, and Vantage emails you when you’re approved.
account.p4: When you set up your trading account, pick the platform (MetaTrader 4 or MetaTrader 5), the account type and your base currency. Not sure? MT5 is the newer platform; either works for gold, silver and crypto.
account.p5: Once approved, deposit from the Client Portal. Start with an amount you can afford to lose, or open a demo account first and practise without real money.

metatrader.p1: MetaTrader is where you’ll see the charts and place trades. You log in with the trading account Vantage created for you.
metatrader.p2: Vantage emails your trading account number and server after setup. You can also find them in the Client Portal under **Accounts**, next to MT4 or MT5.
metatrader.p3: Download the version that matches your account (MT4 or MT5) from the Vantage Client Portal, or get the MetaTrader app from the App Store or Google Play.
metatrader.p4: Enter your account number and trading password, then choose the exact Vantage server shown in your portal. Type the password by hand rather than pasting it.
metatrader.p5: Open MetaTrader, go to **File → Login to Trade Account**, enter your account number and password, select your Vantage server and click Login.
metatrader.p6: In the MetaTrader app, go to **Settings → New Account** (or Manage Accounts → +), search for **Vantage**, pick your server and sign in.
metatrader.p7: You’ll see your balance in the Trade tab and live prices moving. If it says “Invalid account”, check the server name and that MT4/MT5 matches your account.

section4.p1: Open a demo account, follow our Telegram entries and practise the process. *Go live only when it makes sense to you.*
section4.p2: A demo uses the same platform and prices, so everything you learn carries straight over.
section4.p3: Place trades on MetaTrader with no money at risk.
section4.p4: Use the structure, entry and stop-loss from each post.
section4.p5: Risk a small, fixed share of your account per trade.
section4.p6: Look back at every trade, including the losers.

section5.p1: CFDs are complex instruments and come with a high risk of losing money rapidly due to leverage. **Only trade with money you can afford to lose.**
section5.p2: Vantage’s products, terms and protections depend on where you live. Read the risk disclosure and terms for your region before you open an account. Learn Try Earn may earn a referral fee if you sign up through our link.

section6.p1: Join the Telegram for entries and analysis, and watch the full process live on TikTok.
section6.p2: Educational content, not financial advice. Trading involves significant risk.
